title: Three Seals Broken
summary: With all three Basic Relics bonded, the Tri-Basic Seal shatters. The Sovereign Crest manifests on Ha-Jun's body, permanently shifting his eyes to dual-ringed crimson-violet as Hunter Bureau satellites track the massive energy spike.

panels.shot: tri-resonance geometric energy circle
panels.action: Around Ha-Jun, three concentric circles of ancient demonic runes rotate at blinding speed in midair.
panels.prose_en: Around Ha-Jun, three concentric circles of ancient demonic runes rotate at blinding speed in midair.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ke charon or, prachin shaitani demonic runon ke teen sankendrit vritt madhya hawa mein andhi gati se ghumte han.

panels.shot: macro on kuro feather in pocket
panels.action: Kuro's Fallen Feather radiates celestial violet light, resonating with the Ashen Heart.
panels.prose_en: Kuro's Fallen Feather radiates celestial violet light, resonating with the Ashen Heart.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ka gira hua pankh akashiya baingani prakash bikherta hai, jo ation heart ke saath pratidhvanit hota hai.

panels.shot: macro on ring of hollow blood
panels.action: The Ring of Hollow Blood pulses with liquid crimson radiance, circulating power through his veins.
panels.prose_en: The Ring of Hollow Blood pulses with liquid crimson radiance, circulating power through his veins.
panels.prose_hi: Khokhle khoon ki anguthi taral lal rang ki chamak ke saath spandit hoti hai, uski nason mein shakti ka sanchar karti hai.

panels.shot: macro on bone of the forgotten
panels.action: The Bone Gauntlet hums with ivory luminescence, anchoring the explosive energy into his marrow.
panels.prose_en: The Bone Gauntlet hums with ivory luminescence, anchoring the explosive energy into his marrow.
panels.prose_hi: Asthi gauntlet hathi daant ki chamak ke saath gunjan karta hai, visfotak urja ko uske majja mein samahit karta hai.

panels.shot: three beams of light striking ha-jun core
panels.action: The three energy currents intersect directly over the lotus fire crest on his sternum.
panels.prose_en: The three energy currents intersect directly over the lotus fire crest on his sternum.
panels.prose_hi: Teen urja dharayen sidhe uske urosthi par kamal agni shikhar par pratichhed karti han.

panels.shot: celestial sound of ancient chains snapping
panels.action: In Ha-Jun's mental plane, three colossal iron chains wrapped around a black iron throne snap like thread.

dialogue.text:
[SYSTEM NOTIFICATION: TRI-BASIC SEAL SHATTERED]
All 3 Foundation Relics Unified.
Demon Sovereign Bloodline Evolution: STAGE 1 COMPLETE.

panels.prose_en: In Ha-Jun's mental plane, three colossal iron chains wrapped around a black iron throne snap like thread.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ke mansik star par, ek kale lohe ke sinhasan ke charon or lipati teen vishal lohe ki janjeeren dhaage ki tarah tutati han.

panels.shot: shockwave blasting out of bukhansan cavern
panels.action: A column of invisible mana pressure blasts upward through Bukhansan peak, parting storm clouds in a five-mile ring.
panels.prose_en: A column of invisible mana pressure blasts upward through Bukhansan peak, parting storm clouds in a five-mile ring.
panels.prose_hi: Adrishya man dabav ka ek stambh bukanson choti ke madhyam se upar ki or visfot karta hai, jo paanch meal ki ring mein toofani baadalon ko vibhajit karta hai.

panels.shot: blue morning sky revealed through cloud hole
panels.action: Clear blue morning sunlight streams down through the circular hole in the clouds onto the mountain ridge.
panels.prose_en: Clear blue morning sunlight streams down through the circular hole in the clouds onto the mountain ridge.
panels.prose_hi: Subah ki saaf neeli dhoop baadalon ke golakar chhed se hokar parvat shrinkhala par girti hai.

panels.shot: hunter bureau satellite control center
panels.action: Inside the high-tech Hunter Bureau Command Center in Gangnam: red alarms flash across 50 giant screens.
panels.prose_en: Inside the high-tech Hunter Bureau Command Center in Gangnam: red alarms flash across 50 giant screens.
panels.prose_hi: Gangnam mein high-tek hunter bureau command center ke ander: 50 vishal screenon par lal alarm chamakte han.

panels.shot: technician panicking over thermal spike
panels.action: A technician in a black suit drops his coffee mug as digital gauges spike off the charts.

dialogue.speaker: technician
dialogue.text: CHAIRMAN!! Bukhansan Sector 4 mein SSS-Rank energy signature detect hua hai!

panels.prose_en: A technician in a black suit drops his coffee mug as digital gauges spike off the charts.
panels.prose_hi: Jaise hi digital gej chart se bahar nikalta hai, kale suit mein ek technician apna coffee mag gira deta hai.

panels.shot: supreme director kang staring at satellite feed
panels.action: Supreme Director Kang—a cold, silver-haired man in a military trenchcoat—stares at the thermal heatmap.

dialogue.speaker: director_kang
dialogue.text: SSS-Rank...? Demon Kings toh Abyss mein band hain. Yeh kiska wavelength hai?

panels.prose_en: Supreme Director Kang—a cold, silver-haired man in a military trenchcoat—stares at the thermal heatmap.
panels.prose_hi: Suprim director kang - sainya trenchakot mein ek thanda, chandi ke baalon wala aadmi - thermal hitmap ko ghurta hai.

panels.shot: captain baek stepping out of shadows
panels.action: Captain Baek, his arm still bandaged from Chapter 22, enters the office with dark intensity.

dialogue.speaker: captain_baek
dialogue.text: Yeh wahi ladka hai, Director... Ha-Jun Kang. Uska bloodline accelerate ho raha hai.

panels.prose_en: Captain Baek, his arm still bandaged from Chapter 22, enters the office with dark intensity.
panels.prose_hi: Capton bek, jiske haath par abhi bhi adhyay 22 ki patti bandhi hui hai, andhere tivrata ke saath karyalay mein pravesh karta hai.

panels.shot: director kang crushing crystal glass in hand
panels.action: Director Kang crushes his whiskey glass to powder, dark demonic veins flickering beneath his human collar.

dialogue.speaker: director_kang
dialogue.text: Special Kill Team Alpha ko deploy karo. Ha-Jun ko zinda ya murda... mujhe uska dil chahiye.

panels.prose_en: Director Kang crushes his whiskey glass to powder, dark demonic veins flickering beneath his human collar.
panels.prose_hi: Nirdeshak kang ne apne whisky ke gilas ko kuchalkar powder bana liya, uske manav collar ke neeche kali shaitani demonic nasen timtima rahi thin.

panels.shot: back inside cavern ha-jun body transformation
panels.action: Back in the cavern, the blinding light subsides, revealing Ha-Jun's completed evolution.
panels.prose_en: Back in the cavern, the blinding light subsides, revealing Ha-Jun's completed evolution.
panels.prose_hi: Gufa mein vaaps, chakachaundh karne wali roshni kam ho jaati hai, jisse Ha-Jun ke purna vikas ka pata chalta hai.

panels.shot: jet black hair with silver-violet tips
panels.action: Ha-Jun's messy black hair now features subtle silver-violet highlights that catch the light like polished obsidian.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's messy black hair now features subtle silver-violet highlights that catch the light like polished obsidian.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ke gande kale baalon mein ab sookshm silvar-violet highlights hain jo polish kiye gaye obsidian ki tarah prakash ko pakadte han.

panels.shot: dual-ringed eyes permanently set
panels.action: His eyes are permanently altered: sharp violet irises ringed with a thin, glowing crimson outer eclipse.
panels.prose_en: His eyes are permanently altered: sharp violet irises ringed with a thin, glowing crimson outer eclipse.
panels.prose_hi: Uski aankhen sthayi roop se badal gai han: tej baingani rang ki paritarikaen patli, chamakdar lal rang ke bahari grahan se ghiri hui han.

panels.shot: sovereign crest gleaming on sternum
panels.action: The Sovereign Crest on his chest has deepened into a permanent obsidian-and-ruby demonic brand.
panels.prose_en: The Sovereign Crest on his chest has deepened into a permanent obsidian-and-ruby demonic brand.
panels.prose_hi: Uski chhati par Sovereign crest ek sthayi obseedian-aur-rubi shaitani demonic brand mein gehra ho gaya hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun exhaling white mist
panels.action: Ha-Jun breathes out a cloud of white condensation, feeling superhuman vitality coursing through every capillary.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Main ab thaka hua feel nahi kar raha... Mere andar energy ka azeem samundar hai.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun breathes out a cloud of white condensation, feeling superhuman vitality coursing through every capillary.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun safed sankshepan ke ek badal ko bahar nikalta hai, har keshika ke madhyam se alaukik jeevan shakti ko mahsoos karta hai.

panels.shot: kuro perching proudly on ha-jun shoulder
panels.action: Kuro ruffles his obsidian feathers, puffing out his chest with guardian pride.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Stage 1 complete! Ab tum ordinary hunters ke target nahi rahe... Tum unke nightmare ban chuke ho!

panels.prose_en: Kuro ruffles his obsidian feathers, puffing out his chest with guardian pride.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro apne obsidian pankh fadfadata hai, abhibhavak garv se apni chhati fulata hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun summoning and testing abilities simultaneously
panels.action: With a thought, Ha-Jun summons the Bone Gauntlet on his left arm and a Bloodfire Katana in his right hand.
panels.prose_en: With a thought, Ha-Jun summons the Bone Gauntlet on his left arm and a Bloodfire Katana in his right hand.
panels.prose_hi: Ek vichar ke sath, Ha-Jun apne baen haath par bone gauntlet aur apne dahine haath mein ek bladfir katana ko bulata hai.

panels.shot: flaming blood blade reflecting off bone armor
panels.action: The violet hellfire from the crimson blade casts dancing highlights against the polished ivory bone gauntlet.
panels.prose_en: The violet hellfire from the crimson blade casts dancing highlights against the polished ivory bone gauntlet.
panels.prose_hi: Crimson blade se nikalne wali baingani narkankaal polish ki gai hathi daant ki haddi ke gauntlet ke samne nritya ki jhalak dikhati hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun sheathing the blade into his blood
panels.action: Ha-Jun smoothly folds his fingers, dissolving both weapons back into his body seamlessly in half a second.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun smoothly folds his fingers, dissolving both weapons back into his body seamlessly in half a second.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun aasani se apni ungaliyon ko modata hai, aur donon hathiyaron ko aadhe second mein apne shareer mein wapas ghol deta hai.

panels.shot: min-jae voice on walkie-talkie
panels.action: Min-Jae's voice bursts through the radio with breathless excitement: 'Ha-Jun! Pura mountain shake hua tha!'

dialogue.speaker: min-jae
dialogue.text: Tum theek ho na?! Satellite scans mein massive energy spike dikh raha hai!

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae's voice bursts through the radio with breathless excitement: 'Ha-Jun! Pura mountain shake hua tha!'.
panels.prose_hi: Bedam utsaah ke saath min-je ki awaaz radio par gunjati hai: 'Ha-Jun! pura pahad hila hua tha!'.

panels.shot: ha-jun answering with calm confidence
panels.action: Ha-Jun clips the radio to his collar: 'Main theek hoon, Min-Jae. Aur pehle se bohot behtar hoon.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Main upar aa raha hoon. Car start rakho.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun clips the radio to his collar: 'Main theek hoon, Min-Jae. Aur pehle se bohot behtar hoon.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne radio ko apne collar par clip kiya: 'main theek hun, min-je. aur pehle se bahut behtar hun.'

panels.shot: ha-jun leaping effortlessly up the cavern ramp
panels.action: With single 20-foot leaps, Ha-Jun bounds up the basalt incline like a phantom in the shadows.
panels.prose_en: With single 20-foot leaps, Ha-Jun bounds up the basalt incline like a phantom in the shadows.
panels.prose_hi: 20 foot ki ekal chhalang ke sath, Ha-Jun chhaya mein ek pret ki tarah basalt jhukaav ko bandhta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun emerging behind the waterfall
panels.action: Ha-Jun parts the falling sheets of icy water, stepping out onto the sunlit mountain trail.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun parts the falling sheets of icy water, stepping out onto the sunlit mountain trail.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun barfile pani ki girti chadron ko alag karta hai, suraj ki roshni wale pahadi raste par nikalta hai.

panels.shot: min-jae staring in utter awe at hajun
panels.action: Min-Jae freezes with van keys in hand, staring at Ha-Jun's sharpened jawline and glowing dual-ringed eyes.

dialogue.speaker: min-jae
dialogue.text: Ha-Jun... Tumhara aura... Tum bilkul badal chuke ho.

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae freezes with van keys in hand, staring at Ha-Jun's sharpened jawline and glowing dual-ringed eyes.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je haath mein van ki chabiyan lekar thithak jata hai aur Ha-Jun ki nukili jabde ki rekha aur chamakti dohri ring wali aankhon ko dekhta rahata hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun pulling up his windbreaker hood
panels.action: Ha-Jun pulls the black hood over his silver-tipped black fringe, his dual eyes glowing in the shadow.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Hunters humare peeche aane wale hain. Ab humein chupne ki zaroorat nahi hai.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun pulls the black hood over his silver-tipped black fringe, his dual eyes glowing in the shadow.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne apni chandi ki nok wali kali fringe ke upar kala hud khincha hai, uski dohri aankhen chhaya mein chamak rahi han.

panels.shot: three black bureau attack helicopters appearing on horizon
panels.action: Far over the Seoul skyline, three stealth attack helicopters bearing the Hunter Bureau eagle emblem approach.
panels.prose_en: Far over the Seoul skyline, three stealth attack helicopters bearing the Hunter Bureau eagle emblem approach.
panels.prose_hi: Siyol kshitij ke bahut dur, hunter bureau eagle prateek drishtikon wale teen gupt hamle wale helecopter.

panels.shot: ha-jun and kuro facing the approaching helicopters
panels.action: Standing on the granite precipice overlooking Seoul, Ha-Jun and Kuro stare fearlessly at the incoming armada.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Agar Hunter Bureau jung chahta hai... Toh jung hi sahi.

panels.prose_en: Standing on the granite precipice overlooking Seoul, Ha-Jun and Kuro stare fearlessly at the incoming armada.
panels.prose_hi: Siyol ki or dekhne wali granite chattan par khade hokar, Ha-Jun aur Kuro aane wale armada ko nidarta se ghurte han.
